lines.t: I don't have to have the answers,
I don't have to know what's next.
'Cause every time I reach for You,
You're already there.
Looking back, I can see it now,
Every step, You were there somehow.
Through the highs and through the lows,
You have never let me go.
**[Chorus]**
Through every night, every sunrise,
You have been here.
You're in my heart, You're by my side.
You've never failed me all my life.
Though the future's unknown,
I know I'll never walk alone.
Through every season, come what may,
You've never failed me any day.
**[Verse 2]**
Some days I feel like I'm running
With no idea where I'm headed.
But You keep showing up beside me,
Reminding me I'm not alone.
And when I can't see past today,
You remind me that You've made a way.
I don't need to figure it all out,
I've got a reason to trust You now.
**[Chorus]**
Through every night, every sunrise,
You have been here.
You're in my heart, You're by my side.
You've never failed me all my life.
Though the future's unknown,
I know I'll never walk alone.
Through every season, come what may,
You've never failed me any day.
**[Bridge]**
You were here yesterday,
You'll be here tomorrow.
So I can breathe a little deeper,
I can let go of the worry.
'Cause I've seen it time and time again—
You turn my fear into faith.
And whatever comes my way,
I know You won't change.
**[Final Chorus]**
Through every night, every sunrise,
You have been here.
You're in my heart, You're by my side.
You've never failed me all my life.
Though the future's unknown,
I know I'll never walk alone.
Through every season, come what may,
You've never failed me any day.
